notes.text: Students are required to take seven courses in economics, seven courses in mathematics and two courses in information technology. Pre-major requirement: MATH 125 or equivalent.
notes.source_line: Students are required to take seven courses in economics, seven courses in mathematics and two courses in information technology. Pre-major requirement: MATH 125 or equivalent.

notes.text: In Economics: ECON 203 , ECON 205 , ECON 303 , ECON 305 , ECON 318 and at least two other ECON courses at the 400 level or above.
notes.source_line: In Economics: ECON 203 , ECON 205 , ECON 303 , ECON 305 , ECON 318 and at least two other ECON courses at the 400 level or above.

notes.text: In Mathematics: MATH 126 or MATH 127 ; MATH 225 or MATH 245 ; MATH 226 or MATH 227 ; and either sequence one: MATH 407 , MATH 408 or sequence two: MATH 307 , MATH 308 ; and at least two other MATH courses at the 400 level or above (for both sequences).
notes.source_line: In Mathematics: MATH 126 or MATH 127 ; MATH 225 or MATH 245 ; MATH 226 or MATH 227 ; and either sequence one: MATH 407 , MATH 408 or sequence two: MATH 307 , MATH 308 ; and at least two other MATH courses at the 400 level or above (for both sequences).

notes.text: In Information Technology: Two courses required. At least one course from TAC 115 , TAC 116 or TAC 165 ; and TAC 249 .
notes.source_line: In Information Technology: Two courses required. At least one course from TAC 115 , TAC 116 or TAC 165 ; and TAC 249 .

notes.text: A grade of C (2.0) or better is required for each of the core courses ECON 303 , ECON 305 , ECON 318 , MATH 307 and MATH 308 or MATH 407 and MATH 408 .
notes.source_line: A grade of C (2.0) or better is required for each of the core courses ECON 303 , ECON 305 , ECON 318 , MATH 307 and MATH 308 or MATH 407 and MATH 408 .

notes.text: Electives must be approved by the program advisers.
